info.title: JustAVPS API
info.description:
The JustAVPS API lets you programmatically create and manage VPS machines, run commands, manage files, and build infrastructure.

## Authentication

All authenticated endpoints accept:
- **Bearer token**: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx`

Generate API keys in the [dashboard](https://justavps.com/settings).

## Base URL
```
https://justavps.com/api/v1
```

## SDKs

```bash
# TypeScript / Node.js
npm install @kortix/justavps

# Python
pip install kortix-justavps
```

```typescript
import { JustAVPS } from "@kortix/justavps";
const client = new JustAVPS({ apiKey: "sk_live_..." });

// Create a machine
const machine = await client.machines.create({ server_type: "starter", region: "eu" });

// Execute commands
const tb = client.toolbox(machine.id);
const result = await tb.process.exec("echo hello");

// Manage files
await tb.files.upload("/root/app.py", 'print("hello")');
const content = await tb.files.download("/root/app.py");
```

```python
from justavps import JustAVPS
client = JustAVPS("sk_live_...")

# Create a machine
machine = client.machines.create(server_type="starter", region="eu")

# Execute commands
tb = client.toolbox(machine["id"])
result = tb.process.exec("echo hello")

# Manage files
tb.files.upload("/root/app.py", 'print("hello")')
content = tb.files.download("/root/app.py")
```

post.description:
Provisions a new VPS machine. If `image_id` is provided, boots from that image. If omitted, boots from Ubuntu 24.04.

Returns 202 if provisioning starts immediately (user has payment method), or 402 with a `checkout_url` if payment is required first.

image_id.description: Image or built-in template to boot from. Null = default JustAVPS base

env_vars.description: Extra environment variables written to /etc/justavps/env on the machine

docker_image.description: Docker image to run on boot (e.g. "myapp:latest")

command.description: Optional container command/args passed after the image name

ssh_key_ids.description: IDs of user SSH keys to add to the machine. Auto-generated key is always included.

billing_interval.description: Billing interval: monthly, yearly (20% off), or 2year (30% off, billed annually)

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
machine = client.machines.create(
    server_type="starter",
    region="eu",
    name="my-dev-box",
)
print(machine["id"], machine["slug"])

get.description: Returns all non-deleted machines owned by the authenticated user.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

x-codeSamples.source:
from justavps import JustAVPS

client = JustAVPS("sk_live_...")
machines = client.machines.list()

get.description: Returns full details of a machine including connection info, health metrics, and SSH keys.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
const machine = await client.machines.get("machine-id");
console.log(machine.status, machine.ip);

delete.description: Permanently destroys the machine, removes DNS records, cancels billing, and deletes the provider server. **Irreversible.**

post.description: Initiates a hard reboot via the provider API (~30s downtime).

Scales a machine UP to a larger server type. **Only upgrades are allowed** — you cannot downgrade to a smaller plan. The machine is stopped, resized, and restarted (~60-90s downtime). Disk is permanently enlarged. Billing is prorated.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g. downgrade attempt, same plan, invalid type)

post.description: Creates a point-in-time image (snapshot) from a running machine. Machine must be in `ready` status. Returns 202 — poll `GET /images/{id}` until status is `ready`.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
const image = await client.machines.createImage("machine-id", { name: "my-snapshot" });
console.log(image.id);

get.description: Returns all non-deleted images owned by the authenticated user.
Returns image details including status and provider artifact info.

delete.description: Deletes the image and its provider-side artifact.

post.description: Registers a new SSH public key. Automatically uploaded to all providers.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

get.description: Returns all SSH public keys registered by the authenticated user.

post.description: **The full key is only returned once in this response.** Store it securely.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
const key = await client.apiKeys.create({ name: "ci-deploy" });
console.log(key.key); // Only shown once!

x-codeSamples.label: Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
key = client.api_keys.create("ci-deploy")
print(key["key"])  # Only shown once!

get.description: Returns all API keys. Full key value is never returned after creation.

delete.description: Permanently revokes the API key. Requests using it will immediately fail.

get.description: Returns available server types for a provider + region, with pricing.

backup_price_monthly.description: Provider backup cost (20% of provider price)

get.description: Returns current billing period usage including active machines and estimated cost.
Returns Stripe billing portal URL and payment method status.

post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout Session in setup mode to add a payment method.
Sets the initial password for passwordless checkout-created accounts.

get.description: Returns the resource limits and current usage for the authenticated user.

post.description: Called by the justavps-agent on each machine every 60s. Authenticated via `machine_token` in body.
Called by the machine agent to report provisioning progress.

get.description: Called by the Cloudflare Worker to validate API keys at the edge.

Opens a Server-Sent Events stream for real-time provisioning updates.

**Event types:** `status`, `stage`, `done`, `ping`, `error`

Auto-closes on terminal state or after 10 minutes.

get.description: Lists files and directories at the given path on the machine. Supports recursive listing via `depth` parameter.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
tb = client.toolbox("machine-id")
entries = tb.files.list("/root")
for e in entries:
    print(e["type"], e["name"], e["size"])

delete.description: Deletes a file or directory. For non-empty directories, `recursive=true` is required.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
# Delete file
tb.files.remove("/root/old.txt")

# Delete directory recursively
tb.files.remove("/root/project", recursive=True)

get.description: Returns metadata about a file or directory: name, size, permissions, owner, group, modification time.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
const info = await tb.files.info("/root/app.py");
console.log(info.size, info.owner, info.mode_bits);

get.summary: Check if file or directory exists

get.description: Downloads the raw content of a file. Returns the file with appropriate Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
# Text file
content = tb.files.download("/root/app.py")

# Binary file
data = tb.files.download_bytes("/root/image.png")

post.description: Uploads content to a file on the machine. Creates parent directories automatically. Supports raw body or multipart form upload.

get.description: Recursively searches for a regex pattern in files under the given path. Like `grep -rn`.

post.description: Change mode (chmod), owner, and/or group of a file or directory.

paths.description: Absolute file paths to include in the zip

post.description: Runs a shell command synchronously on the machine and returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
result = tb.process.exec("ls -la /root",
    cwd="/root/project",
    timeout=30,
    env={"NODE_ENV": "production"},
)
print(result["exit_code"], result["stdout"])

post.description: Runs a shell command and streams stdout/stderr as Server-Sent Events in real-time. Final event contains exit code.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

post.description: Executes a code snippet in the specified language (python, node, bash, ruby, go). Auto-detects language if omitted.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
# Python
result = tb.process.code_run("print(6 * 7)", language="python")
print(result["stdout"])  # "42\n"

# Node.js
result = tb.process.code_run("console.log({ok: true})", language="node")

# Auto-detect language
result = tb.process.code_run("print('hello')")

get.description: Returns all running processes on the machine with PID, command, state, memory usage, and user.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
const { processes } = await tb.process.list();
processes.forEach(p => console.log(`PID ${p.pid}: ${p.command}`));

post.description: Sends a signal to a process by PID. Supports SIGTERM, SIGKILL, SIGINT, SIGHUP.

Subscribes a URL to receive POST requests for specified events. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 (`X-Signature-256` header).

**Events:** `*`, `machine.stage_changed`, `machine.status_changed`, `machine.heartbeat`

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook POSTs
